manifest.name: Gaffer
manifest.description: Gaffer Direct and Gaffer Inspect on the sites you turn on.
popup.noScripts: Turn on “Allow User Scripts” for Gaffer on the extensions page. Without that setting Gaffer can't do anything on pages.
popup.default: On by default on all sites
popup.permission.lost: Gaffer no longer has access to sites. Switch it on to allow it again.
popup.update.noModules: Update failed: no modules, start npm run dev
bookmarklet.drag: Drag this button to your bookmarks bar:
bookmarklet.direct.help: Remove the old bookmark first. The shortcuts card shows the version at the top.
bookmarklet.inspect.help: Click it on a page with video, preferably while the video has been playing for a while. Then click Report an issue: the report is copied and a new issue opens on GitHub.
direct.volume: Volume: click for the slider, scroll = louder/softer, M = sound on/off
direct.volume.slider: Volume (Page Up / Page Down, or scroll)
direct.level.off: Same level for every video: off
direct.level.on: Same level for every video: on. Level {level}, this video plays at volume {volume}
direct.level.listening: Same level for every video: on, listening to this video first. Level {level}
direct.level.quiet: Same level for every video: on. Level {level}, but this video is too quiet to reach it
direct.level.unmeasured: Same level for every video: on. Level {level}, but the sound of this video cannot be measured, so an average is used (volume {volume})
direct.level.slider: Level for every video (Page Up / Page Down, or scroll)
direct.speed: Speed: click for the slider, scroll = step 0.05 (< / > steps, , / . fine)
direct.osd.levelOff: Same level for every video: off
direct.help.title: Keyboard shortcuts
direct.panel.max.tip: Pick the highest quality automatically, on/off (remembered per site)
direct.panel.reset.tip: Reset everything: rotation, zoom, pan, mirroring, brightness, contrast, speed (0)
direct.top.tools: Picture settings: rotate, zoom, pan, mirror (T)
direct.audio.locked: The audio track is fixed during a recording
direct.share.tip: Share (Shift: copy the link at this moment)
direct.cast.stop: Stop casting or cast to another device
direct.record.confirm: Stop the recording? What has been recorded is saved.
direct.record.notice: Recording may not be allowed. Many sites forbid it in their terms, and the content may be protected by copyright. Only record for your own use and when you are sure it is allowed.
direct.record.notice.nodownload: This site has also turned off the browser's own download option for this video.
direct.record.notice.remember: Don't show again on this site
direct.record.impossible: Recording not possible for this video
direct.record.memory: Your browser can't write straight to disk: the file is kept in memory and downloaded at the end
direct.record.separate: Picture and sound are in separate files. Combine them with: {command}
direct.download.notice: Downloading may not be allowed. Many sites forbid it in their terms, and the content may be protected by copyright. Only download for your own use and when you are sure it is allowed.
direct.download.confirm: Cancel the download? The partial file is removed.
direct.download.codec: the stream uses {codec}, which Direct can't convert
direct.download.format: the stream chunks are in a format Direct can't read
direct.download.structure: the stream's picture and sound can't be combined into one file
direct.quality.locked: The quality is fixed during a recording
direct.quality.codecFallback: {label} can't be played by your browser (codec), back to previous
direct.quality.menuMissing: The site's quality menu wasn't found
direct.quality.noResponse: The site doesn't respond to the quality choice
direct.tell.held: holds back a play() while the pause is held
inspect.button.reported: Copied: paste it into the issue
inspect.issue.reportFile: The report was too long to paste and was saved as {name}: attach that file here.
inspect.button.saved: Saved: attach the file to the issue
inspect.issue.warning: The report contains the address of this page and of its streams. Issues on GitHub are public: check the report before you post it.
inspect.monitor.title: Monitoring: open the site's quality menu, pick another quality, then click Stop
inspect.monitor.heading: Monitor
inspect.monitor.layout: box now {left},{top} {width}x{height}; display {display}, visibility {visibility}, opacity {opacity}, transform {transform}
inspect.report.started.dev: the development version of the extension
inspect.report.browser: Browser: Chrome {chrome}, window {width}x{height} at pixel ratio {ratio}, language {language}
inspect.report.pageErrors.title: Errors since the page loaded
inspect.report.pageErrors.unknown: not known: Gaffer was not running on this page. Monitor catches errors from now on.
inspect.report.pageErrors.since: kept from {time} s after the page loaded (Gaffer started later)
inspect.report.videos.title: Video elements: {n}
inspect.report.videos.blob: blob: (MediaSource, streamed by a JS player)
inspect.report.videos.layout: box: {left},{top} {width}x{height}; display {display}, visibility {visibility}, opacity {opacity}, transform {transform}; ended: {ended}
inspect.report.react.title: React around the player (ancestors)
inspect.report.react.missing: #{index}: no React found on the ancestors
inspect.report.players.title: Known player libraries
inspect.report.players.none: none found as a global variable
inspect.report.tracks.title: Tracks
inspect.report.domPlayers.title: Players recognised by the page structure
inspect.report.direct.bars: bars: {n} (one set per video with a Direct)
inspect.report.direct.none: #{index}: no Direct ({width}x{height} in a window of {windowWidth}x{windowHeight}; needed: almost half the width, half the height or a fifth of the window)
inspect.report.direct.posters: kept as a picture before the start: {list}
inspect.report.direct.position: top bar {top}–{topEnd}, bottom bar {bottom}–{bottomEnd} (window height {windowHeight}), z-index {z}

inspect.report.direct.level.on: same level: on, level {value}, reference loudness {ref} LUFS, this video is the reference: {reference}; this video {loudness} LUFS ({from}), volume set {volume}, audio {context}
inspect.report.direct.level.earlier: kept from before a new capture
inspect.report.direct.level.failed: same level: the sound of this video can't be measured
inspect.report.direct.level.held: same level: measuring waits for a recording
inspect.report.direct.qualityState: Max: {max}, chosen by the user: {user}, unplayable: {bad}
inspect.report.direct.playback: playback: pause held {held}, spinner {loading}, readyState {readyState}, {ahead} s buffered ahead, paused by the buffer guard {guard}
inspect.report.direct.nav.page: previous / next: in page order, videos with Direct {count}, previous {prev}, next {next}
inspect.report.globals.title: Global objects that look like a player
inspect.report.iframes.title: Iframes
inspect.report.network.title: Network
inspect.manifest.name: name {name}
inspect.manifest.hlsMedia: HLS media playlist (one quality, no master)
inspect.record.title: Recording and download
inspect.record.blocked: Recording is not available on this site
inspect.record.warning: Warning: Recording may not be allowed. Many sites forbid it in their terms, and the content may be protected by copyright. Only record for your own use and when you are sure it is allowed.
inspect.record.source.stream: source: MediaStream (srcObject); only re-encoding with MediaRecorder is possible
inspect.record.source.mse: source: blob: (MediaSource); recording through the stream chunks, or downloading from the manifest when it is not live
inspect.record.source.file: source: plain file {url}; downloadable as a file
inspect.record.nodownload: (the browser's download option is off; Direct only warns about this)
inspect.record.capture.off: stream capture: not active (Gaffer Direct not started, or capture not loaded)
inspect.record.capture.none: stream capture: active, but no SourceBuffers seen for this video yet
inspect.record.direct.none: Gaffer Direct: no record button for this video
inspect.record.siteLinks: Download links or buttons of the site itself ({n}):
